thread.title: Mike Khouw Sees Unusual Options Activity In Apple

author: Craig Jones
title: Mike Khouw Sees Unusual Options Activity In Apple
text:
Nick's Picks 2017 Review: Beating The Market Once Again (Seeking Alpha) 
Mike Khouw spoke on CNBC's "Options Action" about unusually high options activity in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ). He said that calls outnumbered puts two to one Tuesday and a lot of that activity was in the January 12 expiration calls. 
During the session, Khouw noticed a purchase of 2,000 contracts of the January 170 calls for $2.50. The trade breaks even at $172.50 or 0.14 percent above the market price. © 2018 Benzinga.com. Benzinga does not provide investment advice. All rights reserved.
